items.title: Chinese Threat Actor Uses Leaked DarkSword Kit to Deploy GHOSTBLADE on iOS
items.description: An unknown Chinese-threat actor has been observed running a campaign targeting Apple iOS devices by leveraging a publicly leaked version of the DarkSword exploit kit. Attack surface management platform Censys said it identified the threat actor running more than 100 web properties, most of which are fake Amazon Web Services (AWS) sign-in pages on a domain that also hosts the exploit toolkit. items.description: The Police National Legal Database (PNLD) has confirmed that police, government and customer contact information was compromised and published on the dark web. The data included names, organisations and work email addresses belonging to police officers, police staff, criminal justice professionals, government partners and customers. items.description: Internet-facing SonicWall Secure Mobile Access, or SMA, appliances face a serious threat after attackers turned two flaws into a route to full VPN-gateway control. The campaign gives an outsider a way to move from a simple web request to root-level access, without a password, session or user interaction. items.description: XCSSET has returned with a way to target macOS developers. The latest version, v40, hides inside poisoned Xcode projects and can turn a local build into a supply-chain compromise. items.title: Thermo Fisher Patches Flaw That Could Make DNA File Tampering Nearly Undetectable
items.description: Thermo Fisher Scientific has patched a flaw in select Applied Biosystems human identification software that could allow data files to be altered before analysis software loads them. items.title: N-able Says Attackers Take Over N-central Servers After Initial Fix Proves Incomplete
items.description: N-able said attackers exploited an authentication bypass in N-central to gain remote administrative access and reach the customer systems managed through those servers. Its first fix was incomplete. CVE-2026-18577 affects N-central builds prior to 2026.3.1.7. N-able shipped build 2026.3.1.7 on August 2 as the first unaffected version.
